description:
About the Position

Utrecht University hosts the Prince Claus Chair and invites applications for a postdoctoral researcher working on inclusive governance within that framework. The Prince Claus Chair is dedicated to research on development-related themes and supports scholars whose work connects governance, equity and development in low- and middle-income country contexts.

The postdoc will develop a research line on inclusive governance, combining conceptual work with empirical studies and engaging with partners in the regions concerned. The position includes teaching and outreach components linked to the chair's programme, and offers a platform within the university's development-studies environment. The appointment is a salaried postdoctoral contract under the CAO-NU collective agreement.

Candidate Profile

Applicants hold a PhD in governance, development studies, political science, public administration or a related field, with a publication record and demonstrable connection to inclusive-governance themes. Experience with field-based research in development contexts is an advantage. The working language is English.

Highlights

  • Inclusive governance in development contexts
  • Equity and development research
  • Conceptual and empirical research line development
  • Engagement with partners in low- and middle-income countries
  • Teaching and outreach linked to the chair
  • Salaried postdoc under the CAO-NU agreement

About Utrecht University

Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe. Its research and teaching span four faculties and a broad range of strategic themes, including sustainability, dynamics of youth, institutions for open societies and life sciences. PhD candidates and postdocs in the Netherlands are salaried staff members with full employment benefits under the CAO-NU collective agreement, so advertised positions are fully funded. Academic and support vacancies are published on the university's working-at portal, with clear deadlines and application instructions per position.
